old_page_claims.chaos: by 32 ticks even inputs on empty cells push twin runs apart by as much as natural variability (inputs section)

coarse.note: oracle spread = within-replicate unbiased variance over R = 6 copies of the same privileged state (base continuation + 5 fresh-noise clones), mean over the view's coordinates, standardised units (1 = the unconditional variance); short curve: all test states, h <= 32; long curve: first test tick only, h <= 96. Crossings: first horizon at which the mean curve reaches the level (log-linear interpolation), bootstrap over trajectories.

objects_gap_tau1.event_definition: slot present at t or t+1 (checker's rule); event = tracker code at t+1 is fusion/fused (fusion), fission (fission, parent or child), birth or presence 0->1 (appearance), death or presence 1->0 (loss)

ar1_base_every_tick.note: AR(1) toward the training mean (folds by trajectory as analyze.closure, rho from all one-tick pairs), error against the base continuation at every tick t = 0..T-1 of every trajectory; bootstrap over trajectories
